topography.project_purpose: Farm. Structurally: 35 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (semver, irisczeroverifier, ownable2step). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
